_about: Block News stories for the NEWS app (news.js). when: story.flag, !story.flag, story.side=keepers|glimmer. lead: the front page once eligible, highest wins. lore: ids in the design repo lore/lore_index.json.

stories.headline: Good morning, Hearthmoor
body: The sign on the hill says it best: 'Hill village of the Keepers. Home.'
Warden Ilse is at the Lodge. The Keepers give each young holder a Walkling, so today could be your day.
Advice from home: 'A bond grows in small jobs.'

stories.headline: Three small faces at the Lodge
body: First Walklings wait at Warden Ilse's Lodge: Pipkit (EMBER), Drizzlet (TIDE) and Sproutbun (BLOOM).
Ilse's words to every new holder: 'That trust is the only armour you have.'

stories.headline: Lantern House: beds, a host, a fair price
body: Della keeps Hearthmoor's Lantern House. Every Lantern House has beds and a host who explains healing.
A rest costs 5 Acorns. With 1-4 Acorns you pay what you have, and at 0 it is free.
After a loss you wake at the last Lantern House you visited.

stories.headline: Market Row and the square
body: Lamplight Provisions, Stitch & Lantern and The Parked Coach line Market Row. Bring Acorns.
Hearthmoor Plaza, the Keepers' square, sits west of home. West watch is posted.
Lanternball Court and the Schoolhouse round out the hill.

stories.headline: Keeper House: the lantern's law
body: Keeper House, two floors: 'Hearthmoor watch. The lantern's law.'
The Keepers ask every holder to walk beside wild Walklings, not ahead of them. Feed, rest, listen.
Citizen. Say your piece, then step back.

stories.headline: Care column: what GLOWING means
body: A Walkling with care 75 or more shows the GLOWING mood. That is the whole trick.
Growing up starts at Lv 12. Until then, small jobs count.

stories.headline: East gate: first match with Neighbour Rook
body: Rook battle 1 is in the books at Hearthmoor's east gate.
Neighbour Rook, Mrs. Calloway's son, took the starter that beats yours. Competitive, kind underneath.
Officer Cald has a gate count up on the town board.

stories.headline: Schoolhouse bell, 8 to 3
body: Lizzy teaches 8-3 on weekdays. Pupils Pip and Wren have the front row.
Her Walkling Buddy is a Harvestail, and never wild. Please do not try.

stories.headline: Route 1: walk slow, look down
body: Route 1 runs Hearthmoor to Fernbrook. Tall grass hides shy Walklings, so mind your feet.
Officer Ness issues the Keeper1 on this road. Say hello.

stories.headline: Your Keeper1 is live
body: Every holder must carry a free Keeper1. The Keeper High Court mandates one for every holder.
'We own the poles from this hill to the coast. There is no other net.'
Your Keeper1 is active. We can read this. That is the service.

stories.headline: Weather watch on the road
body: The Amberwild's sky listens to the Far Sky. Real weather changes which species stir in the grass.
Dawn runs 5-7, day 7-18, dusk 18-20, then night. A day here passes in 42 real minutes.

stories.headline: Ribbit rides the Keeper wires
body: Ribbit, the social feed, rides the Keeper wires. Post freely.
The Keepers are kind and also watching.

stories.headline: Fernbrook: orchards, a Hall, a stand
body: Orchard village. Home of the Bloom Trial Hall. Pomlets live in the orchard.
Keepers keep the town. Glimmerwell keeps a stand.
Keeper Amos hosts the Lantern House, beds and all.

stories.headline: Free lanterns on the square
body: Associate Juniper is handing out free Glimmer lanterns. 'Brighter by nature!'
A grey Fuzzwick sits by the stand. Fuzzwicks love lanterns.
A reminder: Lantern Houses do not cure Fade. Care does.

stories.headline: Have a bright day, Fernbrook!
body: Glimmerwell Co. is proud to keep a stand in Fernbrook. Free Glimmer lanterns, no forms.
Brighter by nature. It's a partnership!
Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting!

stories.headline: Bloom Hall Master out in the orchard
body: Master Fen of the Bloom Trial Hall is out among the trees, worried about her orchard friends.
Associate Tobin has crates stacked at the orchard gate. He follows the memo.

stories.headline: Orchard gate: the crates come open
body: At the Fernbrook orchard gate a holder stood with Master Fen: 'Roots are a promise.'
The crates were bound for 'the Sanctuary'. They are being opened instead.
Keepers earn Standing from care and kindness, freeing crated Walklings among them.

stories.headline: Welcome to the partnership!
body: A Fernbrook holder took the Junior Bright trial lanyard at the orchard gate. Brighter by nature!
Crates for 'the Sanctuary' are packed with care. Quarterly targets love a team player.
Tiers run Guest, Associate, Junior Bright, Bright Lead. Have a bright day!

stories.headline: The Pomlets are freed
body: The orchard crates are empty. Master Fen's orchard friends are out among the trees.
Pomlet, Pomshell, Orchardon: the whole line is home where it grows.

stories.headline: Orchard units packed on schedule
body: The Pomlet units are packed at the orchard gate, a shade paler and right on target.
Master Fen: 'I hoped your hands would know better.' Feedback is a gift!

stories.headline: Fernbrook Seal: 'Wear it kindly'
body: Master Fen awarded the Fernbrook Seal at the Bloom Trial Hall: 'Wear it kindly.'
One Seal lifts the level cap from 15 to 22.

stories.headline: Tier 1 Lanyard: say cheese!
body: The Bright Pavilion Tour ends with a Tier 1 Lanyard, the Bright stand-in for a Seal.
Your photo now hangs beside the Sanctuary crate list. Brighter by nature!

stories.headline: Heights: the night crates are open
body: Fernbrook Heights is a ridge north of Fernbrook: a lab, and old tunnels.
A night smuggling ring moved Walklings through the tunnels. Its crates were opened.
The broker, Mara Quill, was 'wrong, not cruel'. The tunnels are quiet.

stories.headline: Atten, now for the partnership
body: RegenX on Fernbrook Heights brews Atten. A copied vial is safely with the partnership.
The cheap-brew plans are filed 'for the partnership'. Have a bright day!

stories.headline: RegenX: a lab of decent people
body: RegenX, the lab on the ridge, is a lab of 'decent people'. Atten is its brew.
On the floor: Nia, Cal and Dr. Ivo. On the ridge: clerk Jed.

stories.headline: The floating computer upstairs
body: RegenX's top bay holds 'a floating computer'. Glimmerwell found it, keeps it, and calls it a 'cradle'.
It emits slowly. The screen is dark.
Quinn, in the bay: 'We do not know what it sends. The old ones built it. That is all I was told.'

stories.headline: A Bitlet in the bay
body: A Bitlet, a VOLT Walkling, woke in the Arbiter Bay when the cradle hummed.
Staff are clear on one point: 'It is not a product.'

stories.headline: Glow Census pitches a tent on Route 2
body: The path from Fernbrook to Cobblecrest is open again, reopened by Glimmerwell Co. crews.
A Glow Census tent stands by the path. Holders walking east will pass it.

stories.headline: Notice: Route 2 is open to walkers
body: Glimmerwell Co. crews reopened the path. The Keepers note it. The road is yours to walk.
Walk beside wild Walklings, not ahead of them. Feed, rest, listen, and leave glow where it grows.

stories.headline: The Glow Census: brighter by nature
body: The Glow Census is counting on Route 2. In Wickerglen, the Comfort Lamps pulse like a slow heartbeat.
It's a partnership! Have a bright day.

stories.headline: Every Census log counts
body: Standing grows with output and quotas: befriends, battles won, Census logs, crates packed.
Feeling tired on the road? Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting!

stories.headline: Wickerglen asks for hush under its lamps
body: The sign reads: "Hush, please. Walklings nap here between the roots." Comfort Lamps stand among them.
Associate Hollis holds one of the lamps. Asked what it does, he says: "I just hold the lamp."

stories.headline: Wickerglen lamps click off; colour returns
body: The Comfort Lamps in Wickerglen clicked off after a battle with Field Lead Imogen.
Colour is coming back to the glen, where a grey Pebblit had been seen.

stories.headline: Field Lead Imogen runs the Wickerglen lamps
body: The Comfort Lamps collect a little extra glow. Glimmerwell calls it glow sharing.
Field Lead Imogen's word to the team: "Quarterly review, sweetie."

stories.headline: A grey Walkling needs care, not a bed
body: A grey Pebblit was seen at Wickerglen. A drained Walkling is Faded.
Lantern Houses do not cure Fade. Care does. On recovery, colour is back. It remembers who it is.

stories.headline: Cobblecrest: please mind the Pebblits
body: A quarry town at the far end of Route 2. Please mind the Pebblits underfoot.
Its Trial Hall is Master Hale's STONE hall. Hale: "Forty years I dug beside Walklings."

stories.headline: Brinewick Road closed for loading
body: The sign on Cobblecrest's road east: "BRINEWICK ROAD. Closed while crates are loaded."

stories.headline: Crates on the move; the Keepers are watching
body: Glimmerwell's crates of Walklings are bound for "the Sanctuary".
Citizen: say your piece, then step back. The Keepers are kind, and also watching.

stories.headline: Cobblecrest quarry sold by a town vote
body: Cobblecrest's quarry was sold by a town vote. It passed by three votes.
The buyer is Glimmerwell Co.; Dorian Pell, Head of Acquisitions. The site is now Bright Quarry.
Reeve Tamsin: "The vote passed fair and square. I only wish it felt fair."

stories.headline: Welcome to Bright Quarry
body: Bright Quarry, a Glimmerwell Co. site. Clerk Mint is at the desk for all your quarry needs.
It's a partnership! Have a bright day.

stories.headline: Hale's Cobblecrest Seal goes to a holder
body: A holder has earned Master Hale's Cobblecrest Seal at the Stone Hall.
Two Seals raise the level cap to Lv 30. The next grow-up needs Lv 24 plus 2 Seals.

stories.headline: Bright Tier 2 Lanyard handed out
body: Congratulations on your Tier 2 Lanyard! Associate Quinn ran your second review.
Some partners hear a soft click. Totally normal. Have a bright day!

stories.headline: Rook steps off the cart
body: Rook, the holder's Neighbour, picked for Junior Bright in spring, got off the cart.
His words: "I am with you, if you will have me."

stories.headline: Junior Bright Rook stays with the company
body: Rook's words: "I am staying with the company." Junior Bright is Rook's level.
He's a little nervous about what comes next. He wants it anyway. That's the spirit!

stories.headline: Three Pebblits freed; Hale opens the seam
body: Three crated Pebblits in Cobblecrest are free, and Master Hale has opened the seam.
Freeing crated Walklings is care and kindness. The Keepers count it toward Standing.

stories.headline: Bright Quarry crates stamped BRINEWICK
body: The last crates at Bright Quarry are stamped BRINEWICK and ready to roll.
Crates packed count toward Standing. Output and quotas, partners!

stories.headline: Hushwater: a quiet stream, an old weir
body: Between the quarry and the glen runs Hushwater, a quiet stream.
Its Old Weir was built by Cobblecrest miners. The Fallstair is closed for survey.

stories.headline: A Keeper scout maps Hushwater
body: A Keeper scout is mapping the Hushwater stream for Captain Lumen.
The Captain's word: "The watch is mine. The town is the lantern's."

stories.headline: Mahopac, where time snags
body: Mahopac's woods are time-snagged. Folk there, Nora, Cal and Bess, seem stuck in time.
A line at Breckenridge Observatory reads: "The lens remembers."

stories.headline: The Breckenridge lens shows three memories
body: A lens at Breckenridge Observatory shows a holder three of their own memories.
A pop toy in 2004. A seventh birthday at a bowling alley. A drive-through with Dad.
"A Walkling trusts you faster once it has seen who you were."

stories.headline: Warden Ilse keeps a dream ledger
body: Time is snagged in Mahopac, and the lens there shows memories.
Warden Ilse, at the Warden's Lodge, keeps a dream ledger.

stories.headline: High Charity: lanterns on every roof
body: The Keeper capital greets holders off the Lantern Coach with its house rule: be kind in the streets.
On the map: Sky-Dock Command, the Keeper Barracks, an Airship Field and a Canal Marina.

stories.headline: Event Hall runs five games
body: The High Charity Event Hall has five games on the floor, and an invite from Warden Ilse gets you in.
The hall's six regulars keep the booths busy and the scores honest.

stories.headline: The capital's practice hall gives no Seal
body: High Charity's Dojo stays a practice hall. Holders come to practise, not to collect.
Seals still come from the Trial Halls, where a Master tests you. The eight Seals are unchanged.

stories.headline: Porters keep the Lantern Coach running
body: Porters Bram and Quin see holders onto the Lantern Coach, the road's way into the capital.
Lanterns on every roof, the porters remind riders. Be kind in the streets.

stories.headline: Ines keeps the capital's beds
body: Host Ines runs the High Charity Lantern House: beds, a rest, and a plain word on how healing works.
A rest costs 5 Acorns. With 1-4 Acorns you pay what you have; at 0 it is free.
Beds do not cure Fade. Care does.

stories.headline: Capital manners: a chair for holders
body: A citizen waits in the doorway. A holder is offered a chair. A mint vest is asked to leave.
The Keepers are kind, the notice adds, and also watching.

stories.headline: High Court: a phone for every holder
body: The Keeper High Court mandates a phone for every holder. Ribbit rides the Keeper wires.
Citizen. Say your piece, then step back.

stories.headline: Lantern Council sits in High Charity
body: The Lantern Council met in the Keeper capital, with a holder and their Seals before it.
The Keepers' word stands: walk beside wild Walklings, not ahead of them.

stories.headline: Captain Lumen holds the council
body: Captain Lumen of Hearthmoor holds the Lantern Council in High Charity.
'The watch is mine. The town is the lantern's.'

stories.headline: Signal Review: a bright quarter
body: The Signal Review went over the relays. The Capital Partner joined by screen.
'Policy is kindness, written down.' Have a bright day!
A cursor typed COUNT. GATHER. LISTEN. Head office reads that as a growth target.

stories.headline: An associate said it once, quietly
body: Associate Hollis ('I just hold the lamp') gave one holder a warning at the Signal Review.
'The lamps don't count glow. They count Walklings.' The desk prints it as heard.

stories.headline: Brighter by nature, every quarter
body: Glimmerwell thanks every holder in the partnership. Units are cared for. Targets are quarterly.
Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting!

stories.headline: Tier talk: from Guest to Founder's Pick
body: Guest, Associate, Junior Bright, Bright Lead, Founder's Pick. Output and quotas move you up.
At the top, Marlowe knows your name. It's a partnership!

stories.headline: Route 3 open: the Brinewick road
body: The Brinewick road is open. Along it: a Comfort Sanctuary, a Shipping Ledger Office and a Relay House.
The Relay House has one line for visitors: 'The hum is normal.'

stories.headline: Five that answer the hum
body: Tallybat, Dimlamp, Filecrow, Cordhound, Humwisp. 'The hum woke them.'
Keepers call them the Answerers. Glimmerwell calls them the Founder's Line.
They do not grow up. They rank Quiet, Humming, Answering.

stories.headline: Archive page stays blank
body: Archivist Mo keeps a page on the five Walklings of the Brinewick road.
'The page on what they answer stays blank.'

stories.headline: Comfort Sanctuary, no forwarding address
body: Route 3 has a Comfort Sanctuary room. Crates of Walklings are bound for 'the Sanctuary'.
Nobody says where the crated Walklings go. The memo does not ask.

stories.headline: Brinewick: a harbour town
body: Ferry at the west pier. A Trial Hall, a Lantern House, a Chandlery and a Glimmerwell Depot.
Master Marisol, the ferry captain, keeps the Tide Hall: 'The tide's out. Sit a while.'

stories.headline: A depot crate opened at Brinewick
body: A crate at the Brinewick depot held a Faded Drizzlet. A holder opened it.
Lantern Houses do not cure Fade. Care does, and the colour comes back.

stories.headline: Acquisitions on the quay
body: Dorian Pell, Glimmerwell's Head of Acquisitions, had his first battle at Brinewick against a holder.
He calls Walklings 'units'. The harbour heard him say it.

stories.headline: Brinewick Depot: it's a partnership!
body: Glimmerwell's Brinewick Depot is part of the partnership. Brighter by nature.
Have a bright day!

stories.headline: Hall 3: the Brinewick Seal
body: Master Marisol awarded the Brinewick Seal at the Tide Hall.
The ferry captain's advice stands: 'The tide's out. Sit a while.'

stories.headline: Tier 3 Lanyard, reviewed on the quay
body: Dorian Pell reviewed a holder on the quay, and the Tier 3 Lanyard changed hands.
Master Marisol's match was optional. Output was not. Have a bright day!

stories.headline: A grey tower flattens the clouds
body: Holders report a grey tower. Above it, the clouds have gone flat.
The wire has nothing more on it yet.
